Mumbai hit by heavy rains, disrupting train services and boosting water levels

Mumbai experienced heavy rainfall, leading to disruptions in local train services due to waterlogging and track issues. The rains also caused the Tulsi and Vihar lakes to overflow, significantly increasing the city's water stock. The downpour has tested the city's infrastructure and preparedness.
